summary: Created the registration test-design artifact with traceable cases for all planned stories and failure paths: profile schema, name capture, Google consent gate, routing/session safety, and non-browser verification. Evidence reviewed included the registration requirements, package dependencies, Prisma schema, auth config, and sign-in page. Ran allowed non-browser checks successfully: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, and `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`. Browser verification was not run and remains pending per task constraints.
